answer: An applicant posts 25 POA plus three sponsor-signed relic tokens into a public meadow contract. Each relic is the SHA-256 of the sponsor address, applicant address, epoch, and a one-time nonce, published before the next epoch opens. Sponsors must pass a canyon test: their last ten-epoch neighbor sets are pairwise disjoint, and none may share a custody key or invite ancestor with the applicant. The meadow withholds release for five epochs; if several applicants reuse one sponsor set or post near-identical work, every linked relic slashes automatically.
